suggested_titles.academic: The Attack Surface: Adversarial Exploitation of the Coherence Bundle in Spiritual Transformation
suggested_titles.provocative: The One Joint the Adversary Cannot Break

opening_analysis.diagnosis: The opening uses a visual/interactive hover mechanic that engages curiosity, but the thesis (the bundle property and adversarial targeting) is delayed until paragraph 4. The problem is visible immediately (attack vectors), but the core claim is not stated until later. The opening is strong for a web/interactive format but would be weak for a traditional paper.

flow.suggested_reorder: No major reorder needed; the structure is logical. Consider moving the 'Structural Claim' block earlier (after the nine pairs) to immediately state the thesis.

paragraph_function_map.main_point: Joy is the signature of a system held, not dependent on circumstances.
Despair is an entropy signature from collapsed χ and no external input.
Peace is backward-resting consciousness; anxiety is forward-managing.
Patience is the gap between stimulus and response; wrath is collapse of that gap.
Kindness is coherence-preserving contact; cruelty is information destruction.
Goodness is structural alignment; corruption is degradation drift.
Faithfulness is structural consistency; betrayal is network collapse.
Gentleness is calibrated force; arrogance is Godelian violation.
Self-control is coupling to the right source; compulsion is receptor desensitization.
Nine attack vectors correspond exactly to the nine Fruits as dimensions of coherence.
The Fruits co-emerge and co-decay as a unified system, not independently.
The Coherence Bundle Property: Fruits are a bundle, not a menu; partial presence is a diagnostic flag.
CPT symmetries require all three to hold; the bundle property is analogous.
The adversary only needs to compromise one Fruit because the bundle property creates a structural gap.
A person with many Fruits can be brought down by arrogance alone.
Response to attack is to activate all nine, not fight the specific dimension.
Partial armor is an attack surface.
The wrong question is which virtue to improve; the right question is where the joint is exposed.
The adversary targets the weakest joint and waits for cascade.
The Drift Protocol: adversary moves from surrender to performance, fracturing the bundle.

rearrangement_suggestions: Move the 'Structural Claim' block (paragraph 10) to immediately after the nine pairs to state the thesis earlier.
Consider moving the 'Bundle Property' section (paragraph 11) before the 'Structural Claim' to build up to the claim.
The 'Drift Protocol' paragraph (20) could be moved to after the 'Right Question' paragraph (18) for tighter flow.
top_3_fixes: Improve the title to be more specific and curiosity-pulling, e.g., 'The Attack Surface: Adversarial Exploitation of the Coherence Bundle'.
Move the thesis statement (the bundle property and adversarial targeting) to appear by paragraph 2 or 3 instead of paragraph 4.
Add a brief transition between the nine pairs and the 'Structural Claim' to prepare the reader for the shift from list to argument.
